trailLength.description: How long a path takes to fade out, in the same units as the trip timestamps.

fadeTrail.description: Fade the path out behind the playhead. When false, trailLength has no effect.

capRounded.description: Round the ends of the path.

jointRounded.description: Round the joints of the path.

loopLength.description: End of the animation playhead, in the same units as the trip timestamps. Defaults to the span of the source timestamps (max - min).

animationSpeed.description: Playback speed. At 1, each timestamp unit lasts 60ms.

symbologyState.description: Grammar symbology for trail color and width, plus geometry property names. Fill or stroke color becomes getColor; stroke width or circle radius becomes getWidth. widthMinPixels applies when width is unset. With no color rule, deck.gl uses black. geometry.path and geometry.timestamps name the record properties; they default to path and timestamps.

layers.description: Grammar rendering layers. Each layer is an independent rendering pipeline with optional preprocess transforms and encoding rules.
